sql_query.query: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.name, u.email, m.role, m.payout_position, m.status FROM _memberships m JOIN _users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.circle_id = $1 AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM _memberships me WHERE me.circle_id = $1 AND me.user_id = $2) ORDER BY m.payout_position ASC, u.name ASC
